v.addr_bad: address "{addr}" is not a valid CIDR
v.privkey_bad: private_key is not a 32-byte base64 key
v.serverpub_unknown: server public key unknown — click "Derive pub"; client .conf files need it
v.jminmax: jmin must be less than jmax
v.jc_high: jc above 128 adds a lot of junk traffic
v.jmax_high: jmax above 1280 can exceed the MTU
v.s1s2: s1 + 56 must not equal s2 — the handshake packets become distinguishable
v.h_bad: {k} is neither a number nor an "a-b" range
v.h_overlap: {a} and {b} overlap — header values must be distinct
v.i_server_bad: server {k} does not look like a packet template
v.i_client_bad: client {k} does not look like a packet template
v.i_client_missing: server has i1–i5 but no client templates are set — .conf files will omit I1–I5
v.host_unset: client Endpoint host is unset — generated .conf files will have no Endpoint line
v.peer_pubkey_bad: {peer}: public_key is not a 32-byte base64 key
v.peer_psk_bad: {peer}: pre_shared_key is not a 32-byte base64 key
v.peer_ip_bad: {peer}: allowed_ips "{addr}" is not a valid CIDR
v.peer_ip_nothost: {peer}: allowed_ips "{addr}" is not a single host route
v.peer_no_privkey: {peer}: no private key in the vault — cannot generate a .conf
